Section.Title: Dedicated Healing
Section.Hint: A condition that cannot simply be healed away. Once treated, it absorbs healing that would otherwise have gone to hit points, and clears when it has taken enough.

Field.RequiredHint: Hit points of dedicated healing needed to clear this condition. 0 disables the feature for this buff.
Field.DCHint: DC of the Heal check that makes the condition ready to absorb healing. 0 waives the check — using the buff marks it treated outright.
Field.ResetTooltip: Reset progress — clears the treated mark and the healing received so far.
